answer: Each submission hangs on the falcon of a task receipt, and the pulse is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The harbor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
